newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Perdigao cut to hold.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Perdigao cut to hold.

text.p: -- DM Grenfell analyst Dana Voelzke cut the rating for Brazilian meat processor Perdigao SA Comercio e Industria to hold from buy.

-- "We expect net profits for Perdigao (and the meat sector in general) to rise sharply in 1997 as a result of an anticipated seven percent drop in corn prices ...," Voelzke wrote in an April 7 report.
-- "However, we think this has already been incorporated into the share price (up nearly 40 percent off September 1996 lows) ..."
-- The company's preferred shares were up 0.01 real to 2.20 reais in Sao Paulo.
